title: Which menu item is lit on a phone, Back from More, and old page addresses are never tested
what: The tests read the words on the phone bar and the side menu, and one checks the lit row on a computer for Branding and Help. None checks that only Members is lit on the phone bar after a tap, that Back from a page opened from More returns to More, that an old saved address is sent to its new page, or that an address with a slash at the end opens. Nothing checks the lit row for the front desk at all.
expected: A phone test taps each bar item and checks one item is lit, goes More then Plans then Back, and opens an old address and one with a trailing slash.
fix_line: Add one phone test for the lit item, Back from More and old addresses

title: Screen colours and language are tested only for the owner, and never across a sign-out
what: Dark or Light and English or Hinglish are switched in tests only as the owner or in the demo. No test switches them as the front desk, checks the choice survives signing out and in, checks that a member name stays as typed in Hinglish, or opens the panel in a browser that blocks storage.
expected: One desk test switches both, signs out and in, and finds the same choice; a storage-blocked run still switches for the visit.
fix_line: Add a desk test that switches both and signs out and back in

title: The Fees due list and its download are never checked on screen
what: The Your numbers test opens the Fees due page and checks only its heading. No test reads the members on it, their unpaid plans, how old the debt is or the amount, compares an amount with the member page, or downloads its file and checks the columns and row count. The amounts are only checked as data.
expected: A screen test with one owing and one paid member reads the Fees due rows and amount, and downloads the file with the same rows.
fix_line: Check the Fees due rows, amount and file in the numbers test

title: Starting the demo with no internet, and the first-visit words, are never tested
what: The demo is always started with the internet on, and the shared step only taps until Today appears. No test sees "Starting your demo gym…", the error line and "Try again" when it fails, or checks that starting the demo makes no real gym. The first-visit lines ("for Gyms", "Starts empty. You add your own members and prices.") are never read.
expected: A welcome test reads the first-visit words, starts the demo offline and sees the error with "Try again", then starts it online with no new real gym.
fix_line: Add an offline Start demo test and read the welcome words

title: No test checks the bell stays quiet in a hidden tab, or what the front desk hears
what: The ring test runs as the owner with the tab in front: one ring for a new complaint, none on opening, none the next minute. No test hides the tab and checks nothing rings, and no test checks the front desk hears a ring for its own lines and none for the owner complaint.
expected: The ring test hides the tab for a minute and finds no ring, and a desk run finds a ring for its line and none for a complaint.
fix_line: Add a hidden-tab and a desk run to the ring test
